title: Punctual spectrum of a scalar local operator at a point
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, ell different from its characteristic, an algebraic closure Omega of Q_ell, a compatible geometric point (y,iota_y), and a raw constructible Omega-Weil sheaf F on Spec(k0). Let alpha in Omega act as its specified local Frobenius on every vector of the fibre [def-zl-point-weil-flag-data]. Then for every closed point z of Spec(k0) and every beta in the finite-presentation punctual spectrum of F [def-weil-punctual-weights], beta=alpha and the residue field at z has cardinality D.q. Alpha need not be nonzero and the fibre need not have dimension one.

proof.text: The spectrum of k0 has a unique point, whose residue field is canonically k0. Thus its cardinality is q, degree one, and every compatible residue-field embedding into k is identical.

For any finite Weil presentation witnessing beta, apply the canonical scalar/cohomology comparison and the presentation isomorphism to F. Naturality of point transport and its coefficient compatibility identify the extended finite local Frobenius with the specified local operator. Carry its nonzero eigenvector to the fibre of F.
Subtract the beta-eigenvector equation from the alpha-scalar equation. Since the transported vector is nonzero and Omega is a field, beta=alpha. A zero fibre has no nonzero eigenvector.

theorem zl_point_scalar_punctual_spectrum
    (F : sfCommonStageWeilSheaf D l hl (zlPointBase D) Ω) (α : Ω)
    (hα : ∀ v : (zlPointWeilFiber D l hl Ω y ι hι).obj F,
      (zlPointWeilFrobenius D l hl Ω y ι hι F).hom v = α • v)
    (z : {z : (zlPointBase D).left // z ∈ closedPoints (zlPointBase D).left})
    (β : Ω) (hβ : SfPunctualEigenvalue D l hl Ω (zlPointBase D) F z β) :
    β = α ∧ Nat.card ((zlPointBase D).left.residueField z.val) = D.q
